---
title: "Component Layout Viewer"
description: "Use the inline component SVG gallery on the Cells page."
---

Open [Components Layout on the Cells page](public-pdk-examples/index.md#components-layout).
Each existing public SVG has Askr's inline Image Viewer: use **+ / −** to zoom,
drag to pan, and **Fit** to center the whole image. **Expand** moves the viewer
into a floating window; closing it returns the camera to the article. Escape
closes the window and restores focus. Focus an inline image area before using
wheel zoom; otherwise the article scrolls normally.

The gallery displays checked-in image previews without Python or a notebook
kernel. It does not build cells, inspect GDS layers, measure dimensions or
establish native geometry/contact/simulation results. See the
[released Askr viewer guide](https://github.com/arfiligol/askr/blob/v0.8.0/usage/image-viewer.qmd)
for controls and image-viewer limitations.
